summary: Frontend-only regression of the blue/white redesign against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, focused on the follow-ups iteration_7 skipped. Palette + overflow: at 1920x800 and 390x844 every route (/login, /dashboard, /reunion, /family-business, /payments, /meetings, /documents, /contact, /account, /disbursements, /my-statements, /members, /admin) rendered in the modern light blue/white palette with 0 elements right>innerWidth+1 (full * scan including SVG descendants). Screenshots saved to /app/.screenshots/i8_*.png. Route guards: as Victoria (member) direct visits to /disbursements, /admin, /members redirect to /dashboard with 0 protected /api/* hits — no child mount, no 403 background fetch. Admin routes still work. Option-nesting warning gone: 33 <option> nodes in the disbursement create dialog have 0 <span> children (visual-editor no longer injects). Data-save exercises: created TEST_REDESIGN_ disbursement with disbursement-send-email-switch un-checked (checked True→False) — POST 200, ledger 4→5, DB row shows email_sent_at=None (no email sent). Edited reason A→B — PATCH 200, GET confirms 'TEST_REDESIGN_ reason B edited', audit-log now has create+edit entries with reason old/new delta. Receipt PDF via /api/disbursements/{id}/receipt returns 200 application/pdf 2524B, magic '%PDF'. Cleanup done via Mongo (delete_one disbursements + delete_many audit_log). Timezone save+restore: UTC→America/New_York persisted on /api/auth/me, restored to UTC. Member edit modal: member-edit-* opens dialog, Save with unchanged values succeeds ('updated' toast). Content edit via UI edit-mode: /api/content is nested (alerts, reunion, ...) not flat strings; UI edit-mode banner already verified in iteration_7 — did not modify content wholesale per instructions. Documents: search (documents-search) filters 6→documents-empty on 'zzzznomatch' → 6 after clear; category filter re-counts. Mobile Sheet: mobile-menu-button opens role=dialog, Tab focuses mobile-nav-dashboard, Escape closes. Disbursement dialog opens/Escape-closes cleanly. Victoria my-statements own scope 200, cross-user statement 403; PDF link present. Verify page without token shows readable 'This sign-in link is missing its token' copy. No console errors/warnings observed across all flows.
critical_code_review_comments: ProtectedRoute now correctly gates admin routes via allowedRoles and redirects to /dashboard before mounting children — verified no /api leakage.
Backend has no DELETE /api/disbursements/{id} endpoint (returns 405). Not blocking for this iteration but if UI ever needs delete, add a soft-delete route.
FamilyArtwork SVG previously overflowed at 390px; now bounded (0 offenders on every mobile route).
